newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian civil servants strike again over cuts.
newsitem.headline: Austrian civil servants strike again over cuts.

text.p: Thousands of Austrian civil servants on Monday staged their second strike in two weeks to protest against job cuts and a spending freeze by the government.
Some 16,000 finance ministry and customs officials began a 24-hour strike at midnight, a spokesman for the civil servants union said.

Finance ministry officials held a half-day strike two weeks ago to protest at a reduction in staff numbers and an erosion of salaries by cuts aimed at ensuring Austria qualifies for a single European currency.

Many Austrian civil servants, who are protected from redundancy by law and are relatively well-off in comparison with other public sectors in Europe, received no pay increase this year as part of the government's austerity measures.
